svg.text: D03 ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT — MAIN + J9 + IO GAS
Fase 1 · FIXED 5V @ +24V · DevKitC · TC×3 · gas/VFD · Blueprint layout v2 (koridor wiring) · Electrical v1.5
PCB-01 D03-MAIN-CTRL (~120×90 mm) — otak + TC×3 + gas I/O + panel + comms
Note: Flash USB DevKit · U8 DNP (bukan U11)
GAS / VFD / AGIT / COOL / PUMP = U10 PCF8574 @0x20 → J9 (Active per FW)
U11 @0x21 IN: P0 GX · P1 ESTOP · P2/P3 flame · P4 pump · P5 cool
BTN_* Active LOW · ESTOP_SENSE HIGH = UNSAFE · GX103 NC coil interlock
U3 = FIXED 5V VIN≥28V · K_GAS = LC1D09BD 24V · U8 DNP · JANGAN DNP U11
KORIDOR A — power stubs (+24V / +5V / +3V3) · jangan taruh komponen di sini
U1 DevKitC pad → NET D03 (USB ↑ atas)
L3 POT_AIR · L4 POT_BURN · L5 GAS_PRESS · L6 MQ6 · L7 UART2_RX · L8 UART2_TX
L9 BTN_AIR · L10 BTN_DRUM · L11 BTN_BURN · L12 PROX · L14 GND · L15 SERVO · L19 +5V_SYS
R2 MOSI · R3 SCL · R6 SDA · R8 MISO · R9 SCK · R10 CS_BEAN · R11 UART1_TX · R12 UART1_RX
R13 DFPLAYER_TX · R14 CS_MOTOR GPIO0 · R16 CS_ENV · L1 3V3=NC · Pump/Cool=U11 P4/P5
COMMS: SPI→U4/U5/U6 · I2C→U10/U11/U12/U13 · UART1→U7→J4 · UART2→J_H1 Nextion
KORIDOR B — SPI bus + +3V3 ke TC×3 · label NET di koridor ini
GPIO/Pin: UART1 GPIO17/16 · DE via PCF
GPIO/Pin: P0 GX · P1 ESTOP · P2/3 flame
Note: P4 pump · P5 cool btn
KORIDOR C — control ke J9 + input panel (label NET hanya di koridor)
btn BTN Air/Drum/Burn IN via opto
J9 IDC BRIDGE — ribbon MAIN ↔ IO (pin1 / segel merah sama arah)
GAS_EN · VFD_D · VFD_F · AGIT · COOL · PUMP · DAC_D · DAC_F
Ribbon 15–25 cm · JANGAN tertukar J_H1 · salah orientasi = rusak board · pin1 = +24V (bukan 12V)
PCB-02 D03-IO-PWR — industrial gas / VFD (Fase1 LOCKED diskrit)
GAS_EN → R_G → Q_GAS → K_GAS coil (+ GX103 NC) → J_GAS / VX
AGIT / COOL / PUMP → Q_* → K3 / K4 / pump
DAC_D / DAC_F → U20 → 0–10V AI VFD AT1
AC: F_MAIN → E-Stop NC → K_GAS / K3 / K4 / VFD feeds
Coil Kontaktor = 24V (LC1D09BD) · E-Stop NC di bus coil
IO diskrit — jangan diganti modul Fase 1
Net names = KiCad net names (jangan rename)
CARA PAKAI BLUEPRINT INI DI KICAD (JUNIOR)
1. Placement: L2_MAIN_PLACEMENT_ZONES · USB DevKit menghadap tepi/atas silk.
3. Route SPI pendek ke U4/U5/U6 · lalu I2C · UART · GPIO/PCF kontrol ke J9.
4. Setiap panah + label NET = nama net KiCad — jangan rename.
6. DRC 0 · positions.csv jangan masih WROOM / MP1584EN SOT / L4 · U8 DNP · U11 tetap.
